verdict: Paid ads have been off since September 15; Google Business is holding.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 15, and the last 20 days have run with zero spend and no new paid leads — the 6 leads and $180 in spend shown for the 28-day window all came from before that date. Your Google Business Profile has been the only active channel, generating 190 actions and 77 calls this period, though that activity slipped roughly 18% in the most recent 7 days, likely because there is no paid traffic reinforcing it. Instagram reach has also dropped sharply — from roughly 105 interactions per day in early September to near zero — which tracks directly with the spend shutoff rather than any organic issue. Ads are being reactivated and the lead-tracking discrepancy between your intake system and ad platform is being reconciled so counts are reliable going forward. Once spend resumes, you should see both paid leads and Instagram reach recover within the first week.
